observations: Two photos show the same set of 12 small children's picture/story books laid out in a 4x3 grid.

Each cover has an English title (e.g. 'Welcome to my home', 'Different jobs', 'The sea', 'How can I find the milk?', 'The fox and the crow', 'A magic box', 'Costume party', 'A long journey', 'My dog can't read', 'A world without pollution', 'To see a doctor', 'Buying shoes').
Each cover carries a small Chinese badge reading roughly '入门级' (entry level) and Chinese sub-text, indicating a bilingual Chinese-English graded reader series.
Covers are glossy, colorful, cartoon-style illustrations; no visible publisher logo or model number is legible in either photo.

Photo 1 shows the books on a wooden table in daylight; photo 0 shows the same books on a different, duller surface (possibly a bed or sofa), suggesting a stock/promotional photo plus a seller's own photo.
No interior pages, spines, back covers, or any box/packaging are shown.
No visible stains, tears, or bent corners on the visible covers, but only the front covers are shown.
